name: langwatch-platform-app-compat
description: Keeps the start commands of the image before the architecture merge working, with a deprecation warning. Copied to /app/platform/app by infra/docker/Dockerfile.

scripts.start: echo 'langwatch: "/app/platform/app pnpm start" is deprecated; use cd /app/apps/api && pnpm --silent run start' >&2; cd /app/apps/api && exec pnpm --silent run start
scripts.start:app: echo 'langwatch: "/app/platform/app pnpm run start:app" is deprecated; use cd /app/apps/api && pnpm --silent run start' >&2; cd /app/apps/api && exec pnpm --silent run start
scripts.start:workers: echo 'langwatch: "/app/platform/app pnpm run start:workers" is deprecated; use cd /app/apps/worker && pnpm --silent run start' >&2; cd /app/apps/worker && exec pnpm --silent run start
scripts.start:prepare:db: echo 'langwatch: "/app/platform/app pnpm run start:prepare:db" is deprecated; use cd /app/apps/tasks && pnpm --silent task upgrade' >&2; cd /app/apps/tasks && exec pnpm --silent task upgrade
scripts.prisma:migrate: echo 'langwatch: "/app/platform/app pnpm run prisma:migrate" is deprecated; use cd /app/apps/tasks && pnpm --silent task upgrade' >&2; cd /app/apps/tasks && exec pnpm --silent task upgrade
scripts.clickhouse:migrate: echo 'langwatch: "/app/platform/app pnpm run clickhouse:migrate" is deprecated; use cd /app/apps/tasks && pnpm --silent task upgrade' >&2; cd /app/apps/tasks && exec pnpm --silent task upgrade
scripts.lwql:provision: echo 'langwatch: "/app/platform/app pnpm run lwql:provision" is deprecated; use cd /app/apps/tasks && pnpm --silent task lwql-provision' >&2; cd /app/apps/tasks && exec pnpm --silent task lwql-provision
scripts.task: echo 'langwatch: "/app/platform/app pnpm run task <name>" is deprecated; use cd /app/apps/tasks && pnpm --silent task <name>' >&2; cd /app/apps/tasks && exec pnpm --silent task
scripts.prisma:seed: echo 'langwatch: "/app/platform/app pnpm prisma:seed" is deprecated and has no equivalent in this image: the seed is a development tool and is not shipped' >&2; exit 1
scripts.task:backfill-datasets-s3: echo 'langwatch: "/app/platform/app pnpm run task:backfill-datasets-s3" is deprecated and has no equivalent in this image: the backfill ran in the upgrade and no longer exists as a task' >&2; exit 1
scripts.task:migrate-object-storage: echo 'langwatch: "/app/platform/app pnpm run task:migrate-object-storage" is deprecated and has no equivalent in this image: the storage move runs as an upgrade step' >&2; exit 1
